items.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel pump module (recall)

items.t: Fuel can leak from the tank crossover pipe (recall)
items.job: Replace left and right fuel tanks (recall)

items.t: Center brake light can stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace center high-mount brake light (recall)

items.t: Dead 12V battery from audio unit staying on
items.job: Charge and test 12V battery, update audio unit software
items.note: If the battery was damaged by running flat, a new 12V battery adds roughly $150-$300.

items.t: Won't start on first press of the start button
items.job: Diagnose no-start and apply Acura bulletin repair
items.note: Price is for diagnosis. Some 2017 cars have a warranty extension that may cover the repair.

items.t: Power system won't start from a blown fuse
items.job: Diagnose blown fuse B5 and repair the cause
items.note: Price covers diagnosis and the fuse; the part that caused the fuse to blow can cost more.

items.t: Rough or failed shifting from debris in the dual-clutch transmission
items.job: Diagnose transmission codes at an Acura dealer under the bulletin
items.note: Diagnosis only: the repair depends on what the dealer finds inside the transmission and is often a warranty matter on these cars. RepairPal lists NSX general diagnosis at about $122-$179.

items.t: Check engine light from fuel filler EVAP leak
items.job: Diagnose EVAP leak; check whether bulletin BTS170202 applies
items.note: Diagnosis only: a loose cap costs nothing, while the bulletin part or another leak costs more. RepairPal lists NSX general diagnosis at about $122-$179.

items.t: Outside door handle doesn't retract
items.job: Diagnose outer door handle fault
items.note: Diagnosis only: Acura's dealer messages cover several possible fixes, from adjustment to replacing handle parts. RepairPal lists NSX general diagnosis at about $122-$179. May be covered if still under warranty.

items.t: Rattle from the door tweeter area
items.job: Find and fix door rattle
items.note: Covers finding the noise and a simple fix such as padding or re-securing trim. RepairPal lists NSX noise diagnosis at about $153-$224. A dealer may do it free if the car is still under warranty.

items.t: Wind noise from door glass
items.job: Adjust door glass and seals
items.note: Covers finding the noise and a simple fix such as padding or re-securing trim. RepairPal lists NSX noise diagnosis at about $153-$224. A dealer may do it free if the car is still under warranty.

items.t: Rattle or noise from the steering wheel
items.job: Find and fix steering wheel rattle
items.note: Covers finding the noise and a simple fix such as padding or re-securing trim. RepairPal lists NSX noise diagnosis at about $153-$224. A dealer may do it free if the car is still under warranty.

items.t: Rattle or squeak from the carbon fiber gauge visor
items.job: Secure or insulate gauge visor
items.note: Covers finding the noise and a simple fix such as padding or re-securing trim. RepairPal lists NSX noise diagnosis at about $153-$224. A dealer may do it free if the car is still under warranty.

items.t: Climate control buttons stick or rattle
items.job: Apply climate panel bulletin fix
items.note: Covers finding the noise and a simple fix such as padding or re-securing trim. RepairPal lists NSX noise diagnosis at about $153-$224. A dealer may do it free if the car is still under warranty.

items.t: Dashboard creaks
items.job: Insulate dashboard contact points with felt
items.note: Covers finding the noise and a simple fix such as padding or re-securing trim. RepairPal lists NSX noise diagnosis at about $153-$224. A dealer may do it free if the car is still under warranty.

items.t: Clicking from a wheel area while driving
items.job: Diagnose and fix wheel-area clicking
items.note: Covers finding the noise and a simple fix such as padding or re-securing trim. RepairPal lists NSX noise diagnosis at about $153-$224. A dealer may do it free if the car is still under warranty.

items.t: Electric power steering (EPS) failure
items.job: Repair or replace EPS control unit
items.note: Owners report about $500 for a module repair and about $1,600 for a new Acura module. A seized steering rack costs more.

items.t: Timing belt and water pump overdue
items.job: Replace timing belt, water pump and tensioner; adjust valves
items.note: Owners report totals of about $1,800-$2,600 at specialists and dealers.

items.t: ABS unit leaking brake fluid
items.job: Replace ABS modulator with a used or conversion unit
items.note: Owner-reported prices: a used modulator about $1,450, an S2000-based conversion under $1,000 in parts; a new Acura assembly was quoted at about $4,000 (1991 car). Labor is an owner's estimate of a couple of hours for resealing the unit; a swap may take longer.

items.t: Climate control unit fails (leaking capacitors)
items.job: Mail-in repair of the climate control circuit board
items.note: Price is an NSX specialist's board-repair service ($150, later $125). Removing and refitting the unit is extra if a shop does it.

items.t: Slow or failing power windows
items.job: Diagnose window switch, regulator and motor
items.note: Diagnosis only: slow glass may only need cleaning and lubrication or a switch, not new parts. If a regulator is needed, NSX owners report about $500-$525 per side for a new Acura regulator, about $150 for a used one, or about $119 to have the cable repaired by mail.

items.t: Clutch wears out (manual cars)
items.job: Replace clutch
items.note: Owners report about $2,500 for a clutch job.

items.t: Check engine light from EVAP system fault
items.job: Diagnose EVAP leak and replace failed part
items.note: Price covers diagnosis; RepairPal lists NSX check engine light diagnosis at about $153-$224. The failed part adds to that.

items.t: Cracked coolant reservoir or brittle hoses
items.job: Pressure-test the cooling system to find failed parts
items.note: Diagnosis only: the cost depends on how many hoses and which parts need replacing on this mid-engine car. RepairPal lists NSX general diagnosis at about $122-$179.

items.t: Oil leaks from valve covers, cam plugs or VTEC solenoid
items.job: Find the oil leak source
items.note: Diagnosis only: the fix ranges from a VTEC solenoid gasket to both valve cover gaskets. For reference, a Honda valve cover gasket set (one bank; two needed) sells for about $121. RepairPal lists NSX general diagnosis at about $122-$179.

items.t: Immobilizer or key cylinder problems
items.job: Diagnose immobilizer, key or door key cylinder fault
items.note: Diagnosis only: the cause may be a key, the immobilizer system or a worn key cylinder switch. RepairPal lists NSX general diagnosis at about $122-$179.
